from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from typing import Optional

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """One paper from the collection: its own title and which other provided papers it references."""
    title: Optional[str] = Field(description="The title of this paper as it appears in the document")
    references_provided_papers: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of OTHER provided papers (known from the collection summaries) that appear in this paper's reference list/bibliography")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Parse results for all documents in the collection."""
    papers: list[Paper] = Field(description="List of all papers extracted from the documents")
    task_target_papers: list[str] = Field(description="The specific paper title(s) the task asks about, passed from task instructions")
